sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de M. Olier, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856; archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Olier died in 1657; the 1856 edition is public domain.
